title: Great decor idea
text:
Great decor idea. I give this decor 3 stars, in general. For the price, 4 stars. The price is great.

The prints in the frame aren’t the greatest print. The print itself isn’t bad quality. They just are the best graphics. The frame looks a bit unfinished.

I think the overall quality is fine. It isn’t going to fall apart all of a sudden.

The idea of a frame with interchangeable prints is great. Something you can change depending on season or holiday.

I am happy with this purchase. I just have to find a place in my home, or even possibly giving it as a gift to my daughter who is starting to need holiday decor.
